description: This file contains a test script for handling FastCGI application requests asynchronously, including defining a custom ApplicationRequest class, handling input/output streams, and starting an asyncio server to process incoming connections.

classes.name: TestAppRequest
classes.description: A subclass of pylt.fastcgi.ApplicationRequest that manages subprocess execution, reads and writes to stdin/stdout/stderr asynchronously, and handles process lifecycle for FastCGI requests.

methods.name: None received_params(self)
methods.description: Processes incoming request parameters, sets up a subprocess to execute the target script, and starts tasks to handle stdout, stderr, and process wait.

methods.name: None recv_stdin(self, data: bytes)
methods.description: Receives stdin data from the FastCGI request, writes it to the subprocess stdin, or closes stdin if no data.

methods.name: _handle_task_stdout(self, process: asyncio.subprocess.Process)
methods.description: Asynchronously reads output from the process stdout and writes it back to the FastCGI response.

methods.name: _handle_task_stderr(self, process: asyncio.subprocess.Process)
methods.description: Asynchronously reads output from the process stderr and writes it back to the FastCGI response.

methods.name: _handle_task_wait(self, process: asyncio.subprocess.Process)
methods.description: Waits for the subprocess to complete, then cleans up the tasks and marks the request as finished.

methods.name: None handle_fcgi_cgi(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter)
methods.description: Handles an incoming FastCGI connection, creates an Application instance, and runs it.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Sets up the asyncio server to listen on a socket and runs it indefinitely, handling incoming FastCGI connections.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, *, req_id: int, keep_alive: bool) -> None:$/

ctags.name: handle_fcgi_cgi
ctags.pattern: /^async def handle_fcgi_cgi(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:$/

ctags.name: recv_stdin
ctags.pattern: /^    async def recv_stdin(self, data: bytes) -> None:$/
